tasks.short: Compile and present evidence for court actions

steps.what: Collect actual case exhibits, original statements and existing custody records, verify exhibit identity, provenance, access restrictions and permitted court-use scope and define the explicit exhibit index
inputs: Actual case evidence, original statements and custody records
outputs: Verified exhibits, provenance and explicit exhibit-index mapping

steps.what: Assemble the expressly selected actual exhibits and index fields in the proposed court pack, preserving originals and flagging missing exhibit IDs or custody references
inputs: S1 verified actual exhibits and explicit inclusion/index mapping
outputs: Proposed indexed evidence pack and missing-reference exceptions

steps.what: Write the actual factual evidence explanation and check the complete final proposed pack against originals, custody references and actual disclosure scope
inputs: Actual indexed pack and original evidence
outputs: Exact complete final proposed court evidence pack and factual explanation

steps.what: Review the actual completed final evidence pack and decide whether that exact content and recipient route are authorised for court disclosure
inputs: S3 exact final evidence pack and actual case disclosure authority
outputs: Actual approval or rejection of the exact court disclosure

steps.what: Submit only the exact authorised final evidence pack to the actual identified court case through the existing evidence route
inputs: Exact final evidence pack and valid s4 actual disclosure authority
outputs: Actual court evidence submission and receipt result

steps.what: Present the actual evidence in court and answer actual questions about observations, exhibits, methods and limits of personal knowledge
inputs: Actual submitted evidence, original knowledge and court questions
outputs: Actual court evidence presentation and answers

steps.what: Write the actual required case entry after submission and court attendance, distinguishing actual receipt and hearing events from unresolved outcomes
inputs: Actual submission receipt and completed court attendance
outputs: Accurate actual court-action case entry

steps.what: Save the completed entry in the same case record
inputs: Completed actual case entry
outputs: Stored case entry

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} and {OPS_SYSTEM}, the actual case/evidence system, to assemble explicitly selected exhibits and index fields without changing originals. The warden writes and checks the factual explanation; the real disclosure authority reviews the complete final pack before a separate submission through {OTHER}, the existing court evidence route, and the warden presents the evidence in person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual selected exhibit IDs and source references can be repeatedly assembled for the court pack.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit document assembly can preserve originals and generate an index deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Provenance, permitted disclosure and truthful testimony require actual evidence and personal knowledge.
tasks.human_edge: Explain observations accurately and acknowledge what is unknown.

reach.task: Review the actual complete final court pack
reach.learn: Real disclosure scope and submission authority

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit exhibit indexing and document assembly are deterministic while evidence reliability, disclosure and testimony remain human responsibilities.

assumptions: Representative actual evidence-compilation and court-presentation episode, conditional on observed manual pack assembly. Actual investigators and evidence custodians produce exhibits and custody records in existing work; s1 counts retrieval, exhibit/provenance checks and inclusion mapping. No free curated case pack or new evidence collection is assumed.

S2 requires actual case ID, selected exhibit ID, original source reference, custody reference and explicit index order. Missing or incomparable metadata remains manual. It does not judge reliability, select suspects, summarise witness meaning or infer guilt. Try native evidence export/index functions first; existing runtime yields no new human gain.

S3 is actual author writing/checking. S4 must be the real independent case disclosure authority, never author self-approval or an invented reviewer. If actual court procedure differs, map that route before submission. The final pack exists first; any exhibit, redaction, explanatory content, case or recipient change voids a1 and requires renewed review.

S5 is the actual distinct submission with fully retained small time. S6 retains actual presentation; s7 records actual subsequent events. Additional separate filings, messages or orders require their real final-version authority and own actions, not blanket reuse of the pack approval.

Same-system case save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated. Baseline95 focal/5 other-role points; shares are illustrative task work independent of prompt priors. Actual shared evidence capture across task episodes must be counted once in roll-up.
unknowns: Which actual pack assembly fields are still manual?
Who holds the real court disclosure authority and what route applies?
research_questions: Observe actual exhibit compilation, factual explanation, real disclosure authority, submission and court presentation separately.

already_counted.description: Actual evidence verification, factual explanation and complete checking, retained submission, court presentation, actual case entry and ordinary save total80 focal points out of95.
Actual independent disclosure-authority review retains5 points, equivalent to5/95 of focal baseline.

incremental.description: Maintain exhibit-index mappings and verify assembly integrity beyond retained case-level provenance and factual checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final court evidence pack from s3, all exhibits, redactions, factual explanations, case identity and intended court recipient route; changes require renewed s4 authority

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:15 actual assembly points/95*100-3=12.789, rounded down12.7. Low: historic exhibits lack stable IDs or custody references, retaining11 of15 assembly points manually and allowing only4 consistent index points to save;4/95*100-3=1.210, rounded down1.2. Source25, factual checking14, authority5, submission1, court35, entry4 and save1 remain. An exhibit-provenance metadata case, unmeasured.

tasks.short: Protect native wildlife, plants and ecosystems

steps.what: Read actual habitat or species management instructions and current site information using native area and programme views
inputs: Actual site, species or habitat records and existing protection instructions
outputs: Verified protection context

steps.what: Carry out actual field presence, habitat observation and public or colleague engagement to protect the native wildlife, plants or ecosystem
inputs: Actual habitat, wildlife and real field conditions
outputs: Actual protection work and observations

steps.what: Assess actual observed threats, ecological context and uncertainty and determine appropriate follow-up within the actual protection programme
inputs: Actual observations and existing protection context
outputs: Actual threat assessment and follow-up needs

steps.what: Write the actual required protection observation entry using native site and programme fields, retaining actual ecological detail and uncertainty
inputs: Actual completed fieldwork, assessment and verified site identifiers
outputs: Accurate actual protection observation entry

steps.what: Save the completed entry in the same protection record
inputs: Completed actual observation entry
outputs: Stored protection observation

tasks.design: Use {OTHER}, the existing habitat mapping and programme tools, and {DOCS} references for actual protection context and {OPS_SYSTEM} for the existing observation entry. Field presence, ecological assessment and real visitor or colleague engagement remain human work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Matching actual habitat context and entering repeated site identifiers can require clerical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native area views and record fields can reduce that work.
tasks.still_hard: Threats depend on actual species, habitats and field conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Notice ecological changes and respond appropriately to people in the field.

ambition.what: Support the actual protection episode with less reference work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native habitat views and site-linked fields can reduce clerical work while field protection and ecological assessment remain human work.

assumptions: Representative actual field-presence and habitat-protection episode, not a measured mixture of every conservation intervention. Actual programme staff produce existing instructions; s1 counts reading and checking them and s2 actual field observation. No free clean wildlife sensor feed is assumed.

Actual required record writing is split in s4. Its reduction covers site/programme fields, not ecological meaning. Try native habitat views and existing record templates first; existing use earns no new benefit. No new report after every visitor conversation is invented.

The episode does not conceal capture, relocation, culling, machinery work, a formal restriction order or an external notice. Any such actual intervention requires its real current operating authority, final version where relevant and separate action before estimating its benefit.
Ordinary same-system save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated, without saving or self-approval. Shares are illustrative task effort independent of prompt time priors.
unknowns: Are actual habitat and programme identifiers mapped to the observation form?
What protection entry is actually required?
research_questions: Observe actual field protection and separately count source lookup, ecological judgement and genuinely required record writing.

already_counted.description: Actual context checking, field protection, ecological assessment, retained entry and ordinary save remain in s1-s5.

incremental.description: Maintain habitat/programme reference links beyond retained field-specific checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:10*.20+9*.10=2.9 gross less1 upkeep=1.9. Low: habitat boundaries and programme identifiers are not mapped consistently to the record form, leaving all10 lookup and9 entry points manual; no unhelpful view or upkeep is introduced. Field protection60, ecological judgement20 and save1 remain. A habitat-boundary mapping case, unmeasured.

tasks.short: Patrol assigned areas to enforce laws or manage wildlife programmes

steps.what: Read the actual patrol assignment, area map and current applicable fish, game or boating restrictions using native assignment and area views
inputs: Actual assigned area and existing current patrol restrictions
outputs: Verified patrol context and actual assigned area

steps.what: Patrol the actual assigned area by the permitted vehicle or on foot, observing real conditions and speaking with people as required by actual patrol duties
inputs: Actual assigned area, people and field conditions
outputs: Actual patrol coverage, observations and conversations

steps.what: Write the actual patrol record after the patrol, describing real coverage, observations and unresolved issues without generated factual claims
inputs: Actual completed patrol and observations
outputs: Accurate actual patrol record

steps.what: Save the actual patrol record in the same existing patrol system
inputs: Completed actual patrol record
outputs: Stored actual patrol record

tasks.design: Use native {OPS_SYSTEM} assignment and {OTHER} patrol-map views with actual {DOCS} restrictions to find the real patrol context. Keep physical patrol, public interactions and actual factual patrol-record writing with the warden.
tasks.previous_blocker: Matching an assignment to current area references may require navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native assignment and area views can reduce that lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Actual patrol coverage and field judgement require presence and observation.
tasks.human_edge: Notice an actual problem and communicate appropriately with the public.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: assignment-linked area views can reduce lookup while physical patrol and factual reporting remain human work.

assumptions: Representative routine observation patrol, not a measured mix of vehicle types or all enforcement encounters. Actual supervisors produce assignments and rule owners maintain restrictions; s1 counts matching and reading them, s2 actual physical patrol and observation. No automated surveillance, risk profiling or clean observation feed is assumed.

Actual patrol record writing is separated in s3. Check native patrol templates first; without demonstrated repeated field entry no reduction is claimed to the14 actual writing points. No expected time saving is borrowed from generic report drafting.

Actual citation, search, seizure, arrest, rescue, separately controlled vehicle operation or formal notice is not treated as a hidden completed action inside routine patrol. A real encounter requiring one needs its actual authority and distinct action before expanding this episode.

Existing native map and assignment runtime already used earns no new benefit. Ordinary same-system save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated, with no saving or author self-approval. Shares are illustrative task work independent of prompt priors.
unknowns: Are assignment areas linked to the applicable current restrictions?
Which actual patrol fields, if any, are repeatedly entered today?
research_questions: Observe actual routine patrol and split context lookup, field time and factual record writing before considering a new change.

already_counted.description: Actual assignment checking, physical patrol, actual factual record writing and ordinary save remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain assignment-to-area links beyond retained per-patrol restriction checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:10*.10=1 lookup point less.3 upkeep=.7. Low: the actual assignment uses informal area descriptions without an indexed map boundary, so all10 lookup points remain manual and no new view/upkeep is deployed. Physical patrol75, actual record writing14 and save1 remain. An assignment-area georeference case, unmeasured.

tasks.short: Investigate hunting accidents or fish and game law violation reports

steps.what: Read the actual accident or violation report and applicable case context through native case and site views
inputs: Actual report, existing case records and relevant site context
outputs: Verified initial investigation context

steps.what: Investigate the actual scene, observe physical evidence and interview actual witnesses or involved people, preserving what was actually observed and said
inputs: Actual scene, people and available physical evidence
outputs: Actual observations and witness accounts with uncertainty

steps.what: Write the actual evidence inventory and factual interview or observation entries, capturing real source IDs, stated times, time uncertainty and custody references
inputs: Actual evidence, observations and interview accounts
outputs: Actual recorded facts, source IDs and explicitly qualified timestamps

steps.what: Order actual recorded events by explicit comparable timestamps and source IDs and segregate missing or uncertain times without inferring a causal sequence
inputs: S3 actual recorded source IDs, qualified timestamps and explicit comparability rules
outputs: Literal source-linked chronology and unresolved-time list

steps.what: Assess actual investigation evidence and contradictions against original accounts, determine supported findings and identify unresolved cause or violation questions
inputs: Actual originals, literal chronology and unresolved evidence
outputs: Actual investigative findings and uncertainty

steps.what: Write the actual working findings entry with supporting evidence, contradictions and remaining questions
inputs: Actual investigative findings and checked source references
outputs: Actual written working investigation findings

steps.what: Save the actual entries in the same case workspace
inputs: Completed actual evidence and working-findings entries
outputs: Stored actual investigation records

tasks.design: Use native {OPS_SYSTEM} case views and explicit ordering of actual recorded event times. The warden conducts the actual investigation, writes factual source entries and assesses contradictions; the chronology only organises supplied facts.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual recorded events may be reordered manually despite explicit timestamps.
tasks.enabler_now: Native chronology views or a fixed timestamp sorter can order comparable events deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain recollections, causation and supported violation findings require actual investigative judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish what a witness stated from what the evidence establishes.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: literal ordering of comparable recorded event times is deterministic; witness meaning, reliability and investigative findings remain human responsibilities.

assumptions: Representative actual scene-and-witness investigation with observed manual chronology work, not a measured mix of all accident and violation cases. Actual reporters produce the initial report; s1 counts reading/checking it and s2 actual evidence and account collection. S3 explicitly counts factual writing and source/timestamp capture, so there is no free structured event feed.

S4 needs actual event/source ID, stated timestamp and time basis, explicit uncertainty and source reference. Missing or incompatible times are not automatically normalised. It does not decide credibility, guilt or causation. Try native case chronology first; existing use earns no new runtime saving.

Actual interpretation is retained in s5 and actual findings writing in s6, separate from interviews. No generated witness narrative is accepted. Any actual search, seizure, notice, prosecution referral or external report needs its real distinct authority and final-version action; none is hidden in the case save.

Ordinary same-system save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated with no saving or author self-approval. Shares are illustrative task work independent of prompt priors; actual overlapping court-pack evidence capture must be deduplicated in roll-up.
unknowns: Is there actual repeated chronology assembly beyond existing native views?
Which event times have a comparable time basis?
research_questions: Observe an actual investigation and count field interviews, factual source writing, literal chronology assembly, interpretation and findings writing separately.

already_counted.description: Actual source checks, scene/witness work, factual evidence and timestamp entry, investigative assessment, findings writing and ordinary save remain in s1-s3 and s5-s7.

incremental.description: Maintain timestamp comparability rules and chronology-source links beyond retained factual and investigative checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:10*.10=1 case-navigation point plus10 actual chronology points less2 upkeep=9. Low: uncertain witness times leave8 of10 chronology points for manual source-by-source treatment and only2 comparable points sort automatically;2+1-2=1. Actual scene/interview55, evidence and timestamp writing15, assessment5, findings writing4 and save1 remain. A witness-time comparability case, unmeasured.
